# Half-finger composite fixture

This fixture is generated procedurally by `build_fixture.py` for repository tests. It contains no
external image, trademarked render, or downloaded game asset. It reproduces the STRUCTURE of a
marketplace listing — several views in one image, a caption band, a tiled watermark, a saturated
backdrop, a single glove rather than a pair — and none of its content.

The generated views are synthetic evidence scaffolding, not a claim of metric or visual authenticity
for a commercial CS2 item. A run against a real listing image is local-only; see `README.md`.

License: MIT for the fixture generator and generated test data.
